doc.field: Morlion, Father Felix - HRL's Speeches and Writings Project (folder 1 of 2)

Includes a memo dealing with a possible book Morlion was planning to write using HRL's speeches and writings. Contains the following Luce speeches "Business Enterprise - 20th Century U.S.A.," "The Promised Land," "The Public Philosophy and the Spirit of Geneva," "Imperfect Freedom," "Journalism and Reponsibility," "The Rule of Law and the Administration of Justice," "Challenges to the Church," "The Title Deeds of Freedom," and "The Meaning of the Rule of Law to American Foreign Policy." HRL's articles include "The Day of Wrath," "America and Armageddon," "Holmes Was Wrong," and "The Character of the Businessman."
